subject: Performance cadence: joint benchmarking deep-dive & ops handoff
messages:
From: Sara Holden <sara@flux-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question — load profile + schedule for performance review

hey Rishi,

Thanks for the brief sync last week. We want to move from discovery -> an ops-oriented benchmarking session so we can validate throughput/latency under our production-ish workload. Two goals for the session: get an architecture-level runthrough from your side and agree on a shared load test plan (targets, data profile, success criteria).

A few quick details from our side:
- Primary workload: multitenant inference (batch + real-time fallbacks). Peak expected steady-state: ~40k tokens/sec sustained for 10 minute windows; short spikes to ~70k tokens/sec for ~30s.
- 99th pctl latency target: <220ms for 1k token responses in the real-time path.
- We'll need a canary plan and an ops roll-forward if the benchmark causes degradations.

Can you propose a 60–90 minute slot next week? Prefer mornings PST. Also please list ops owners who will join (loadtest leads + infra oncall).

Attached: small snapshot of our traffic profile.

—Sara
Sara Holden
Engineering Manager, Flux Analytics
[sara@flux-analytics.com]

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Performance cadence: joint benchmarking deep-dive & ops handoff

Hi Sara — thanks for the details, very helpful.

We can run the session as a technical deep-dive + bench planning workshop. Proposed agenda (60–90 mins):
1) 10m — introductions & objective alignment
2) 25m — Redwood architecture walkthrough (runtime, routing, cache/batching strategy)
3) 25m — proposed load test plan (targets, sequence lengths, dataset sampling, metrics we’ll collect)
4) 15–30m — runbook and canary / rollback discussion (roles, monitoring, alert thresholds)

Availability windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-30, 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-12-01, 10:00–11:30
- Fri 2026-12-03, 08:30–10:00

Marissa will own the runbook and coordinate telemetry hooks; Marcus will own the load driver config and infra readiness; Laura will manage the calendar/invite and recording.

Attachments: draft "benchmark-requirements-v2.docx" (contains the sampling plan + perf KPIs) and our ops checklist. Can you confirm which of the proposed windows works and whether you prefer a 60 or 90 min slot?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
